references.label: Alternating top lanes
references.description: The four rollover lanes at the top; either the first and third or second and fourth pair is lit.

references.label: Left field-progress spinner
references.description: The left-side spinner advances the ball downfield and is the main repeat shot when its return is safe.

references.label: Right field-progress drop bank
references.description: The right-side drop targets advance field position but can rebound sharply.

references.label: Upper-right field route
references.description: The open upper-right path returns the ball toward the top lanes and adds field progress.

references.label: Staggered upper and lower flippers
references.description: Each side has an upper and lower flipper with a rubbered-post return between them.
